Following retaliatory Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries, Russia has extended its ban on jet fuel exports until March 31, 2027. "The government continues its efforts to ensure a reliable and uninterrupted supply of fuel to the domestic market. A resolution has been signed prohibiting the export of jet fuel, including fuel purchased through exchange trading," the Russian government announced. The restrictions do not apply to jet fuel shipments made under international intergovernmental agreements. According to Bloomberg, oil refining volumes in Russia have fallen to their lowest level in more than 20 years. Since the end of October, Ukraine has attacked at least 18 Russian oil refineries.
